meta.instagramCaption:
🚨 BLS Polymers me chance tha 1 in 128. Is IPO me lagbhag 1 in 3! Bombay Coated & Special Steels IPO kal band ho raha hai 👇

💰 Price band: ₹78-₹82 | Lot: 182 shares | Min: ₹14,924
📈 Subscription: ~4x (QIB ~6.9x, NII ~1.9x, Retail ~3.2x)
🎟️ Retail ~3x subscribed = allotment chance lagbhag 3 me se 1
🎯 GMP: ~₹7-₹10 (~9-12%), unofficial rumor
📅 Allotment: 3 Nov | Refund/Demat: 4 Nov | Listing: 5 Nov
🏭 100% fresh issue: ₹183 crore, koi OFS nahi

⚠️ Reality check:
• Revenue ~20% badha, profit sirf ~7%
• Raw material ek hi primary supplier se aata hai

💡 Pro tip:
Allotment milna aasan ho, iska matlab ye nahi ki IPO accha hi hoga. Demand kam hone ki wajah bhi samjho!

Aap isme apply kar rahe ho ya avoid? Comment me batao 👇

Follow @techwith.GenZ for daily market aur tech updates.

⚠️ Disclaimer: Ye sirf educational information hai, investment advice nahi. Invest karne se pehle apna research karo ya SEBI-registered advisor se salah lo.
